data.name: Futuh
data.gender_notes: Futuh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fataha' which means 'opening' or 'conquering'. This name holds significance in Islamic history as it was used to describe the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) early conquests and spread of Islam. The name Futuh carries the meaning “Opening, Conquering” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Futuh usually hope their child will grow to embody opening, conquering and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Futuh represents the spiritual journey of opening one's heart to the divine and conquering the inner self. It is a reminder to keep pushing forward and to never give up in the pursuit of self-improvement and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Futuh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Opening, Conquering.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Futuh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: فتوح
in_arabic.meaning: فتوح تعني فتح و پیروزی، گشایش و موفقیت
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فتوح از ریشه ف-ت-ح مشتق شده است که در لغت به معنی فتح و پیروزی، گشایش و موفقیت است. در قرآن کریم نیز این ریشه به کار رفته و به معنای گشایش و فتح الهی است. فتوح نامی است که نشان دهنده موفقیت و پیروزی فرد در زندگی است.

in_urdu.name: فتوح
in_urdu.meaning: فتوح مطلب ہے فتح و فتحی، کامیابی اور فتح
in_urdu.long_meaning: فتوح نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ ف-ت-ح سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فتح و فتحی، کامیابی اور فتح۔ یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ فتح و پیروزی کا ایک حسین منظر پیش کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फुतुह
in_hindi.meaning: फुतुह का अर्थ है فتح और जीत, सफलता और विजय
in_hindi.long_meaning: फुतुह नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्दों फ-त-ह से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है فتح और जीत, सफलता और विजय। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि यह सफलता और जीत का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: فتوح
in_pashto.meaning: فتوح د فتح او بریا د معنا لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: فتوح نوم د عربی ژبې د کلمو ف-ت-ح څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د فتح او بریا معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره سم دی، چې د بریا او فتحې څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: Futuh
in_english.meaning: Futuh means conquest, victory, success and achievement
in_english.long_meaning: The name Futuh is derived from the Arabic root f-t-h, which signifies conquest, victory, success, and achievement. This name holds significant importance in Islamic tradition as it reflects the concept of divine opening or victory. The name Futuh symbolizes success, triumph, and spiritual advancement in life.

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic context, the name "Futuh" serves as a reminder of the early military and political victories achieved by the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Muslim community during the first few years following his emigration to Medina. These conquests, also known as the "Ridda Wars" or "Wars of Apostasy", played a crucial role in establishing the Islamic state and expanding its influence beyond the Arabian Peninsula.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name "Futuh" represents the idea that truth and knowledge shall always prevail over ignorance and oppression. The Islamic conquests of this period were not merely about territorial expansion or military conquests, but were also about spreading the message of Islam and bringing people into the fold of the faith.
